title: Zero Hour Atlas
description: Maps early warning last-mile gaps in the Jamuna-Padma char corridor: where floods, failed roads and submerged mobile towers cut settlements off at the same time. Built for the RIMES Mapathon 2026.
tools: Python, Google Earth Engine, Sentinel-1, QGIS
image_alt: Zero Hour Index map of char settlements in the Jamuna-Padma corridor

title: Bangladesh Prevailing Wind Direction and Speed
description: Maps annual 10 m wind over Bangladesh from ERA5 reanalysis, with streamlines and wind roses for major cities.

title: Bangladesh Cyclone Tracks and Exposure Corridor
description: Reconstructs 12 major cyclone tracks toward Bangladesh from 1970 to 2024 and turns them into a severity-weighted exposure corridor.
image_alt: Cyclone tracks and exposure corridor map of Bangladesh

title: Pabna Urban Forest
description: Code for my thesis: a canopy model trained on UAV imagery labels a city-wide satellite classifier, then crowns are converted to biomass, carbon and ward statistics for Pabna Municipality.

title: CVI-HazardFusion
description: Fuses the Climate Vulnerability Index with satellite flood, drought and landslide signals into a Dynamic Risk Score for all 64 districts of Bangladesh.
tools: Python, Google Earth Engine, Sentinel-1, MODIS, CHIRPS

title: Bangladesh Temperature Map Generator
description: Automated pipeline that turns a GeoJSON and a date into a daily temperature map, from Open-Meteo and BMD data.
image_alt: Minimum temperature map of Bangladesh on 29 December 2025

title: Pabna Surface Water Temperature Analysis
description: Satellite thermal analysis of surface water dynamics across Pabna District, with maps and statistics.
image_alt: Surface water temperature map of Pabna District

title: Pabna Groundwater Analysis
description: Maps groundwater depth and depletion across Pabna District from observation well data.
image_alt: Groundwater depth map of Pabna District

title: Landsat 8 Harmonic Modeling
description: Harmonic regression on Landsat 8 time series for Pabna District to model seasonal land surface change.
